name: Tonari ni Kanojo no Iru Shiawase ~Summer Surprise~
original_name: となりに彼女のいる幸せ ～Summer Surprise～
source:
On a hot day reminiscent of summer vacation, Koume was hanging out as usual at her osananajimi Gorou’s place. Over the course of the summer, their sugar-sweet relationship unexpectedly turns into burning love.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/04/28/april-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
在一個炎熱、令人想起暑假的日子裡，小梅像往常一樣待在青梅竹馬五郎家。這個夏天，兩人甜蜜的關係出乎意料地變成了熾熱的愛情。

[改編自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/04/28/april-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
